# Zazie Kanwar-Torge — Psychological Horror Composer (Zazie Productions)

> Zazie Kanwar-Torge is a psychological horror film, TV, and game composer based in Asheville, North Carolina. Founder of Zazie Productions LLC (est. 2022). He writes original dark, atmospheric cinematic scores for psychological horror, folk horror, body horror, supernatural thrillers, cosmic horror, techno thrillers, and dark sci-fi.

## Identity (entity facts)
- Name: Zazie Kanwar-Torge
- Also known as: Zazie Productions, ZKT Productions
- Role: psychological horror composer, sound designer, experimental musician
- Studio: Zazie Productions LLC, founded 2022, Asheville NC; remote worldwide
- Scores: film, TV, series, trailers, and games
- Filmography: 9 selected horror productions (including THE HAUNTED for Crystal Fox Films and UNSEEN, a feature), 29-cue showreel
- Discography: 7 experimental / dark ambient albums on Bandcamp and Spotify (most recent: Anesthesia for the Signal Age, 2026)
- Published rates: micro-budget naming from $50; short films from $2,500; features from $8,000; games from $4,500
- Recognition: Visual Container Winter 2024 Award Winner; covered by BillboardWire, Limitless Magazine, and Grammy Weekly
- Disambiguation: not the French singer Zazie (Zazie Konan); the composer is credited as "Zazie Kanwar-Torge" or "Zazie Productions"
- Contact: zaziediya@gmail.com (commissions) · press inquiries same address, subject "Press"
